questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Echinostoma spp.?
options: Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Unembryonated operculated eggs in stool. Wet mounts and concentration at 100–400×; adult or molecular identification improves species certainty.
